description: ERP lookup tools for the Risk Analyst. In Agentstudio each is an Integration tool backed by Uday's U-07 process; in the Claude fallback (N-09) each calls the mock ERP directly. All are read-only and tenant-scoped (Boomi sends X-Tenant-ID from the case, never from the model).

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Supplier master record (name, location, status, capacity_per_week, performance, disruption history) for one supplier id.

tools.name: get_open_purchase_orders
tools.description: All OPEN purchase orders for a supplier, with lines (item_id, qty, due_date, unit_price).

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: On-hand, reserved, safety stock and daily demand per location for one item.

tools.name: get_alternate_suppliers
tools.description: Alternate suppliers for one item: qualified flag, lead_time_days, unit_price, capacity (units/week; null = unknown).
